volk_en/01_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.speaker: volk
volk_en/01_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>He says he lent a stalker coupons for a gun. A Fora, Ward issue, with green trims. You won't mix it up with any other.
volk_en/01_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.text: He says he lent a stalker coupons for a gun. A Fora, Ward issue, with green trims. You won't mix it up with any other.

volk_en/02_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.speaker: volk
volk_en/02_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.tagged_text: The sniper had one just like it. <|emotion:bitterness|>Burned into my memory.
volk_en/02_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.text: The sniper had one just like it. Burned into my memory.

volk_en/03_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.speaker: volk
volk_en/03_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>I made a deal with Huron if I get that Fora I'll cover the stalker's debt myself. <|prosody:speed_fast|>Threw in a bit extra too so he'd tell me where to look for the debtor.
volk_en/03_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.text: I made a deal with Huron if I get that Fora I'll cover the stalker's debt myself. Threw in a bit extra too so he'd tell me where to look for the debtor.

volk_en/04_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.speaker: volk
volk_en/04_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>Every gun is on record in the Ward's databases. <|emotion:determination|>Who it was issued to, who carried it, when it was written off.
volk_en/04_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.text: Every gun is on record in the Ward's databases. Who it was issued to, who carried it, when it was written off.

volk_en/05_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.speaker: volk
volk_en/05_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.tagged_text: <|prosody:pitch_low|><|emotion:determination|>Once I have the rifle, I'll find someone to run it through the databases. Maybe I'll at least learn the <|emotion:determination|>bastard's name.
volk_en/05_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.text: Once I have the rifle, I'll find someone to run it through the databases. Maybe I'll at least learn the bastard's name.

volk_en/06_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.speaker: volk
volk_en/06_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>Huron says he's hanging around somewhere near the Cement Factory. <|prosody:speed_fast|>Hiding from his thugs, most likely.
volk_en/06_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.text: Huron says he's hanging around somewhere near the Cement Factory. Hiding from his thugs, most likely.

volk_en/07_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.speaker: volk
volk_en/07_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.tagged_text: Just don't drag your feet. Huron's thugs are looking for <|emotion:determination|>him too, and they won't stand on ceremony.
volk_en/07_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.text: Just don't drag your feet. Huron's thugs are looking for him too, and they won't stand on ceremony.

volk_en/08_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.speaker: volk
volk_en/08_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>Bring me the Fora and I'll pay you well.
volk_en/08_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.text: Bring me the Fora and I'll pay you well.

volk_en/09_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.speaker: volk
volk_en/09_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>I get it. <|emotion:bitterness|>I'd go myself, but who'd look after Cordon? <|prosody:expressive_low|>If you change your mind, you'll find me here.
volk_en/09_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.text: I get it. I'd go myself, but who'd look after Cordon? If you change your mind, you'll find me here.

volk_en/10_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.speaker: volk

His first shot hit me, and he didn't finish me off. <|prosody:pitch_low|>I lay there bleeding, and my guys came for me one after another. <|emotion:bitterness|>He dropped every one of them. Used me as bait, the <|emotion:anger|>bastard.

volk_en/12_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.speaker: volk
volk_en/12_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.text: The Decider, huh… Give it here.

volk_en/13_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.speaker: volk
volk_en/13_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.tagged_text: Right… Green trims, just like I remember. <|emotion:relief|>And the serial's intact, nobody filed it off.
volk_en/13_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.text: Right… Green trims, just like I remember. And the serial's intact, nobody filed it off.

volk_en/14_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.speaker: volk
volk_en/14_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.tagged_text: I'll cover Huron's debt, like we agreed. And this is for you. <|emotion:contentment|>You've earned it.
volk_en/14_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.text: I'll cover Huron's debt, like we agreed. And this is for you. You've earned it.

volk_en/15_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.speaker: volk
volk_en/15_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>I don't know, Skif. <|prosody:expressive_low|>But it's the only lead I've got.
volk_en/15_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.text: I don't know, Skif. But it's the only lead I've got.

volk_en/16_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.speaker: volk
volk_en/16_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>At least now I <|emotion:relief|>have somewhere to start.
volk_en/16_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.text: At least now I have somewhere to start.

volk_en/17_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.speaker: volk
volk_en/17_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.tagged_text: <|emotion:determination|>Then hurry. If his thugs find him first, you'll be looking for that Fora all over the Zone.
volk_en/17_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_TurnIn.text: Then hurry. If his thugs find him first, you'll be looking for that Fora all over the Zone.

volk_en/18_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.speaker: volk
volk_en/18_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.tagged_text: I do. Remember that Fora you brought me? I managed to run <|emotion:pride|>its serial.
volk_en/18_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.text: I do. Remember that Fora you brought me? I managed to run its serial.

volk_en/19_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.speaker: volk
volk_en/19_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>I found a name. <|prosody:pause|>After that, nothing. Where he serves, where they transferred him, no trace. <|prosody:pitch_low|><|emotion:bitterness|>Like he vanished into thin air.
volk_en/19_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.text: I found a name. After that, nothing. Where he serves, where they transferred him, no trace. Like he vanished into thin air.

volk_en/20_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.speaker: volk
volk_en/20_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>Never mind. <|prosody:pitch_low|><|emotion:determination|>If the papers don't have the answer, I'll have to ask people.
volk_en/20_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.text: Never mind. If the papers don't have the answer, I'll have to ask people.

volk_en/21_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.speaker: volk
volk_en/21_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.tagged_text: <|prosody:pitch_low|><|emotion:determination|>I want to take a couple of Ward soldiers alive. <|prosody:expressive_low|>Question them, maybe one of them knows something. <|prosody:pitch_low|>But first I have to get close to them.
volk_en/21_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.text: I want to take a couple of Ward soldiers alive. Question them, maybe one of them knows something. But first I have to get close to them.

volk_en/22_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.speaker: volk
volk_en/22_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>I've got an idea. <|emotion:determination|>But I can't pull it off without a Falcon. <|prosody:speed_fast|>PSZ-9I, the Spark make.
volk_en/22_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.text: I've got an idea. But I can't pull it off without a Falcon. PSZ-9I, the Spark make.

volk_en/23_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.speaker: volk
volk_en/23_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>The Ward and the Spark don't get along. <|emotion:amusement|>They see one in an expensive suit, they'll get curious. <|prosody:expressive_low|>They might even want to take him alive.
volk_en/23_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.text: The Ward and the Spark don't get along. They see one in an expensive suit, they'll get curious. They might even want to take him alive.

volk_en/24_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.speaker: volk
volk_en/24_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>My lad hangs around their post, and once they go after him, he leads them where we want. <|emotion:determination|>That's where we'll be waiting for them.
volk_en/24_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.text: My lad hangs around their post, and once they go after him, he leads them where we want. That's where we'll be waiting for them.

volk_en/25_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.speaker: volk
volk_en/25_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.tagged_text: That's why it has to be a Falcon. A plain jacket won't do. And my lad's no rookie.
volk_en/25_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.text: That's why it has to be a Falcon. A plain jacket won't do. And my lad's no rookie.

volk_en/26_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.speaker: volk
volk_en/26_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.tagged_text: I'll ask questions. Maybe at least one of them knows where to look for <|emotion:determination|>that sniper.
volk_en/26_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.text: I'll ask questions. Maybe at least one of them knows where to look for that sniper.

volk_en/27_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.speaker: volk
volk_en/27_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>Then I'll keep looking. Won't be the first time.
volk_en/27_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.text: Then I'll keep looking. Won't be the first time.

volk_en/28_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.speaker: volk
volk_en/28_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>I heard there's a Falcon hidden in a stash somewhere near Malachite. <|prosody:pause|>Might still be there.
volk_en/28_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.text: I heard there's a Falcon hidden in a stash somewhere near Malachite. Might still be there.

volk_en/29_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.speaker: volk
volk_en/29_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.tagged_text: <|emotion:contentment|>Good. <|prosody:expressive_low|>I'll pay for the suit, and throw in something from my own supplies on top.
volk_en/29_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.text: Good. I'll pay for the suit, and throw in something from my own supplies on top.

volk_en/30_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.speaker: volk
volk_en/30_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>Suit yourself. If you change your mind, drop by.
volk_en/30_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_Accept_.text: Suit yourself. If you change your mind, drop by.

volk_en/31_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_TurnIn_.speaker: volk
volk_en/31_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_TurnIn_.tagged_text: So, did you GET the suit?
volk_en/31_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_TurnIn_.text: So, did you GET the suit?

volk_en/32_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_TurnIn_.speaker: volk
volk_en/32_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_TurnIn_.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>So do I. I don't like my lads taking risks over my business.
volk_en/32_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_TurnIn_.text: So do I. I don't like my lads taking risks over my business.

volk_en/33_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_TurnIn_.speaker: volk
volk_en/33_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_TurnIn_.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>Anyway, a deal's a deal. <|emotion:contentment|>Here are your coupons. <|prosody:expressive_low|>And I've marked a stash on your PDA. There's something useful in it, it's yours.
volk_en/33_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_TurnIn_.text: Anyway, a deal's a deal. Here are your coupons. And I've marked a stash on your PDA. There's something useful in it, it's yours.

volk_en/34_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_TurnIn_.speaker: volk
volk_en/34_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_TurnIn_.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>He knows what he's getting into. <|emotion:determination|>And I'll do everything I can to bring him back.
volk_en/34_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_TurnIn_.text: He knows what he's getting into. And I'll do everything I can to bring him back.

volk_en/35_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_TurnIn_.speaker: volk
volk_en/35_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_TurnIn_.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>Keep looking. <|emotion:bitterness|>The longer we drag this out, the harder it'll be to find that bastard.
volk_en/35_WolfArmorFetch_Dialog_TurnIn_.text: Keep looking. The longer we drag this out, the harder it'll be to find that bastard.

volk_en/36_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_O.speaker: volk
volk_en/36_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_O.tagged_text: They talked. <|prosody:pause|>Not about where the sniper sits, <|emotion:bitterness|>though. <|prosody:expressive_low|>That they don't know.
volk_en/36_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_O.text: They talked. Not about where the sniper sits, though. That they don't know.

volk_en/37_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_O.speaker: volk
volk_en/37_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_O.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>Not quite. They know his crew. His crew sells Ward guns on the side. To the bandits in Sultansk.
volk_en/37_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_O.text: Not quite. They know his crew. His crew sells Ward guns on the side. To the bandits in Sultansk.

volk_en/38_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_O.speaker: volk

volk_en/38_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_O.text: That's how a Ward Fora ended up with a stalker who didn't have a coupon to his name.

volk_en/39_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_O.speaker: volk
volk_en/39_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_O.tagged_text: <|emotion:determination|>I want you to get them talking. <|prosody:expressive_low|>They'll tell a buyer from Sultansk more than they'd ever tell me. They know my face. They don't know yours.
volk_en/39_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_O.text: I want you to get them talking. They'll tell a buyer from Sultansk more than they'd ever tell me. They know my face. They don't know yours.

volk_en/40_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_N.speaker: volk
volk_en/40_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_N.tagged_text: Here. <|emotion:amusement|>Wrote it down best I could — my handwriting's worse than my aim. <|prosody:expressive_low|>Only show it if you have to.
volk_en/40_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_N.text: Here. Wrote it down best I could — my handwriting's worse than my aim. Only show it if you have to.

volk_en/41_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_H.speaker: volk
volk_en/41_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_H.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>The Sultan's people don't buy direct. A go-between handles the deals. <|emotion:amusement|>Vasyan Bariga.
volk_en/41_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_H.text: The Sultan's people don't buy direct. A go-between handles the deals. Vasyan Bariga.

volk_en/42_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_H.speaker: volk
volk_en/42_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_H.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>He hangs around somewhere north of Sultansk. Only he knows where and when they meet. <|emotion:determination|>The rest is on you.
volk_en/42_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_H.text: He hangs around somewhere north of Sultansk. Only he knows where and when they meet. The rest is on you.

volk_en/44_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_A.speaker: volk

volk_en/44_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_Accept_A.text: Here's the Decider, the same Fora. Patched it up and put some good parts on it. It's yours now.

volk_en/47_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_TurnIn_P.speaker: volk
volk_en/47_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_TurnIn_P.text: Now I know where he sleeps.

volk_en/48_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_TurnIn_P.speaker: volk
volk_en/48_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_TurnIn_P.tagged_text: <|emotion:contentment|>Here, you've earned it. <|prosody:expressive_low|>The rest is my business. <|prosody:pitch_low|><|emotion:determination|>Sooner or later, he's mine.
volk_en/48_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_TurnIn_P.text: Here, you've earned it. The rest is my business. Sooner or later, he's mine.

volk_en/49_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_TurnIn_P.speaker: volk
volk_en/49_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_TurnIn_P.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>I've waited this long. <|prosody:pitch_low|><|emotion:determination|>I can wait a little more.
volk_en/49_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_TurnIn_P.text: I've waited this long. I can wait a little more.

volk_en/50_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_TurnIn_N.speaker: volk
volk_en/50_WolfArmorFetch_Cover_TurnIn_N.text: Take your time. Just don't get caught.

volk_en/51_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.speaker: volk
volk_en/51_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.tagged_text: <|prosody:speed_fast|>There's one job. A personal one. <|emotion:bitterness|>Remember I told you how a Ward sniper shot me?
volk_en/51_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.text: There's one job. A personal one. Remember I told you how a Ward sniper shot me?

volk_en/52_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.speaker: volk
volk_en/52_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.tagged_text: <|prosody:expressive_low|>I am. <|prosody:pitch_low|><|emotion:determination|>And I won't rest until I find him.
volk_en/52_WolfArmorFetch_Decider_Accept.text: I am. And I won't rest until I find him.
